cases.note: graph focus 'adjacency': hover node b (its edges and their ends stay normal, the rest blurs, b emphasis: lift, scale, z2 + 10), the edge b-c, the label of a (the node's hover), leave
a graph on the cartesian of a bar series: the graph's hover (focus adjacency, blurScope coordinateSystem) blurs the bars too; a bar's (focus 'series') blurs the graph
graph focus 'self' blurScope 'global' with a pie: hovering a node blurs the pie; the pie's slice (focus 'self', global) blurs the graph -- its labels and arrows too

highlight / downplay: a node by name (adjacency focus blurs), an edge by dataType 'edge', notBlur, highlightKey; hovering the highlighted node and leaving keeps it (hbo); downplay; a downplay of everything

graph selectedMode 'multiple': clicks select a node (default select border, the primary token) and an edge (the edge data's name 'a > b' in the same map); select / unselect / toggleSelect actions with dataType 'edge'; hovering a selected node lifts its fill

a legend hides category k0 (node a): the edge data drops a-b and a-c (filterSelf), so an edge's data index is not its link's row; selectedMode 'single': click the edge b-c (edge data 0, link 1), then c-d, select by action the raw index 1 (b-c again: its link's row, edge data 0), hover c-d, leave

declared emphasis / blur / select styles on nodes (item, category, series) and edges (link, series); a disabled node and a disabled edge: no hover at all, and under another hover only their declared blur opacity
node itemStyle.opacity (series and item) under blur; a node's own label (show, color, position, formatter) and its category's; edgeLabel rotate / offset (series, and one link's own)
tree focus 'descendant': hover A (A and A1, A2 stay, the rest blurs; an edge leaves the blur only with a node whose parent is not blurred), hover B1, leave
tree focus 'ancestor' on the series, 'relative' on B (item), 'self' on A2: hover A1, B, A2, leave
tree focus 'descendant' blurScope 'global' with a pie: the pie blurs under the tree's hover; the pie (focus series, global) blurs every tree node, edge and label

tree highlight (descendant focus from the payload's element), downplay; selectedMode 'single' clicks with a declared select colour; select action by name; emphasis.disabled on a leaf (leaves model) and a declared emphasis colour / blur opacity / edge emphasis colour

tree focus 'ancestor': highlight A1 by action (blurs the rest, A1 held), then hover A1 itself -- blurSeries blurs the held node too and the ancestor indices (A1 among them) leave blur, the held node takes no hover: A1 ends normal; leave, downplay

treemap focus 'descendant' with declared emphasis (color, strokeColor, strokeWidth, borderColor for the background) and blur colours; hover the parent A's header (its background is the dispatcher), the leaf a1 (its node group), B; leave. Labels and upper labels take itemStyle.opacity (series 0.8, a2 0.4)
treemap focus 'ancestor'; a2 emphasis.disabled (no dispatcher, but the default proxy stays: blurred to a tenth); hover a2 (nothing), a1, A, leave
treemap selectedMode 'multiple' (declared select color / strokeColor): click a1, select A by action (its background only), highlight B and A by action (focus self), downplay; hover a selected leaf
a treemap and a pie, both blurScope 'global': the treemap's hover blurs the pie, the pie's every treemap rect and label

the breadcrumb: hover its items (emphasis colour, z2 + 10, the text's emphasis style), their mouse events (selfType 'breadcrumb', nodeData), a click on a crumb (treemapZoomToNode; the view is then 'animating' for good without a timer, so later crumb clicks would do nothing), leave
the breadcrumb's own emphasis: no declared emphasis text colour (createTextStyle of an empty model), the default emphasis item colour; a leaf drilled into (rootToNode) gives three crumbs
[R2-B] a hovered node's label rides its scaled symbol (updateInnerText on the path as drawn): right (b), top (c), inside (d: stays), left (e, symbolSize 20: ratio max(1.1, 3 / 10))
[R2-B] a hovered tree node's label rides its scaled symbol: A (left), A1 (a leaf: right), B1x

[R2-B] a graph edge takes the pointer within zrender's stroke threshold, max(lineWidth, 5) / 2 a side (Path.contain, no fill): a-b is 2 wide -- 3 px off it nothing, 2 px off it the edge; c-d is 12 wide -- 5 px off it the edge, 7 px off it nothing
[R2-B] a legend (z 4) over the breadcrumb (the treemap's own group, z 2): the pointer on both is the legend's -- its hover highlights the pie -- not the crumb's; a crumb in the clear is its own
[R2-B] a click on a leaf (nodeClick zoomToNode): the view's own dispatch, {type, from: its uid, seriesId, targetNode: the TreeNode}

[R2-I3] a node's itemStyle border, the node's own over its category's over the series' (categoryVisual extends the category style, found by name or index; dataStyleTask the item's own): the series #333333 at 2; a by the category k0's NAME (border C3 at 4, opacity 0.6); b its own width 5; c an emptyCircle (its colour at 2 over the ground); d category 0 by index; e the series'. emphasis width 6 and focus self, selectedMode single (the primary border). Hover b, click e, hover c, leave
[r2v] a graph edge 2 wide at a fraction of a pixel: e at y 99.75 puts a-b at y 100.2496; 2.25 px off it the edge (the threshold max(2, 5) / 2 = 2.5), 3.25 px off it nothing
